integrity: The all-\(n\) argument is symbolic. Exhaustive enumeration through order \(14\) is a finite consistency check only and is not used as an infinite proof. The same-object prior scalar result is explicitly separated from the new all-set enumerator and upper-parameter conclusion.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to the standard barbell \(B_n\) with \(n\ge2\). It proves the exact all-set enumerator and the minimal-set classification, but makes no claim about polynomial roots, unimodality, log-concavity, or other asymptotic properties. Literature coverage can miss unindexed sources.
title: Isolated-domination polynomial of barbell graphs
